name: toy_box
description: a small wooden toy box in the corner, painted with fading circus animals. the lid is heavy. inside: a collection of old toys, all broken or damaged. a doll with no head. a horse with no legs. a jack-in-the-box that won't open.

params.success_message: at the very bottom of the toy box, beneath all the broken toys, you find a small music box. it's dented but intact. when you wind it, it plays a haunting, tinny lullaby — the same melody as the one in the nursery.
